stories.headline: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.6-Plus, Its Third Proprietary AI Model in Three Days, With Enhanced Agentic Coding

key_facts.fact: Qwen3.6-Plus is Alibaba's third proprietary, closed-source AI model released within a three-day period, designed to shift from passive assistance to autonomous agentic AI.
key_facts.excerpt: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. has released its third proprietary AI model in as many days

key_facts.fact: The model provides a 1-million-token context window by default and is optimized for the 'capability loop' — perceive, reason, and act within a single workflow.
key_facts.excerpt: Qwen3.6-Plus provides a 1-million-token context window by default... optimized for the 'capability loop'—the ability to perceive, reason, and act within a single workflow

key_facts.fact: In frontend and repository-level engineering, Qwen3.6-Plus autonomously plans, tests, and iterates on code to deliver production-ready solutions across the full development lifecycle.
key_facts.excerpt: In frontend website development and repository-level engineering, Qwen3.6-Plus autonomously plans, tests, and iterates on code to deliver production-ready solutions

key_facts.fact: The model will be integrated into Alibaba's Wukong enterprise platform and Qwen App, and is compatible with third-party coding assistants including OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cline.
key_facts.excerpt: integrated into Alibaba's ecosystem, including Wukong, an AI-native enterprise platform... compatible with leading third-party coding assistants—including OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cline

key_facts.fact: Qwen3.6-Plus is available on OpenRouter for free during a limited preview period and can interpret UI screenshots, wireframes, and prototypes to generate functional frontend code.
key_facts.excerpt: The model can now interpret user interface screenshots, hand-drawn wireframes, or product prototypes and instantly generate functional frontend code

stories.headline: Arcee Releases Trinity-Large-Thinking, Open-Source 400B MoE Model Ranking #2 on PinchBench Behind Opus 4.6

key_facts.fact: Trinity-Large-Thinking is a 400B total / 13B active mixture-of-experts reasoning model released under Apache 2.0, positioned as the strongest open model released outside China.
key_facts.excerpt: On many axes, it is the strongest open model ever released outside of China

key_facts.fact: The model scores #2 on PinchBench (measuring agentic task capability) behind Opus 4.6, while costing $0.90 per million output tokens — roughly 96% cheaper.
key_facts.excerpt: It scores #2 on PinchBench... just behind Opus-4.6 while landing at $0.90 per million output tokens on our API, roughly 96% cheaper

key_facts.fact: The predecessor Trinity-Large-Preview served 3.37 trillion tokens on OpenRouter in its first 2 months and was the #1 most used open model in the US on OpenRouter's OpenClaw collection.
key_facts.excerpt: The model later crossed just 3.37 trillion tokens served on OpenRouter in its first 2 months, and OpenRouter's OpenClaw collection has Trinity Large Preview as the #1 most used open model in the U.S.

key_facts.fact: Trinity-Large-Thinking uses 'thinking' before responding for stronger multi-turn tool calling, better context coherence, and more stable behavior across long-running agent loops.
key_facts.excerpt: the new checkpoint uses 'thinking' prior to responding... This enables stronger multi-turn tool calling, better context coherence, cleaner instruction following, and more stable behavior across long-running agent loops

key_facts.fact: The model weights are available on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, with Arcee framing permissive American open weights as necessary for the US to claim AI leadership.
key_facts.excerpt: The weights are available on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. We are releasing it this way because we continue to believe that permissive American open weights are necessary for the US to fully claim that we're 'leading' in AI

sources.title: Trinity-Large-Thinking: Scaling an Open Source Frontier Agent

stories.headline: Chinese Chipmakers Capture 41% of Domestic AI Accelerator Market as Nvidia's Share Drops to 55%

key_facts.fact: Chinese GPU and AI chip makers captured nearly 41% of China's AI accelerator server market in 2025, eroding Nvidia's once-dominant position, according to IDC data reviewed by Reuters.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese GPU and AI chip makers captured nearly 41% of China's AI accelerator server market last year, eroding Nvidia's once-dominant position

key_facts.fact: Total shipments of AI accelerator cards by Nvidia, AMD, and Chinese chipmakers reached approximately 4 million units in China in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Total shipments of AI accelerator cards by Nvidia, AMD, and Chinese chipmakers reached approximately 4 million units in China in 2025

key_facts.fact: Nvidia remained the market leader with around 2.2 million cards shipped (55% share), while AMD held 4% with roughly 160,000 cards.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia remained the market leader, shipping around 2.2 million cards and holding a 55% share... AMD carved out a modest presence, shipping roughly 160,000 cards for a 4% share

key_facts.fact: Huawei led Chinese vendors with approximately 812,000 AI chips shipped (roughly half of domestic shipments), followed by Alibaba's T-Head with 265,000 cards.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei Technologies emerged as the runaway leader among Chinese vendors, shipping around 812,000 AI chips... Alibaba's chip design unit T-Head claimed second place, shipping approximately 265,000 cards

key_facts.fact: Baidu's Kunlunxin and Cambricon each shipped around 116,000 cards, while Hygon, MetaX, and Iluvatar CoreX accounted for 5%, 4%, and 3% of Chinese vendor shipments respectively.
key_facts.excerpt: Baidu's Kunlunxin and Cambricon each shipped around 116,000 cards... Hygon, GPU startups MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX accounted for 5%, 4% and 3% of total Chinese vendor shipments

stories.headline: Anthropic Issues 8,000+ DMCA Takedowns to Contain Claude Code Leak as Kairos Agent Mode Revealed

key_facts.fact: Anthropic filed copyright takedown requests that resulted in the removal of more than 8,000 copies and adaptations of Claude Code source code from GitHub.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic had filed copyright takedown requests that briefly resulted in the removal of more than 8,000 copies and adaptations from GitHub

key_facts.fact: Anthropic said the DMCA takedown was intended for one repository but reached more than intended because the repo was part of a fork network connected to Anthropic's own public Claude Code repo; they retracted the notice for all except the target repo.
key_facts.excerpt: We issued a DMCA takedown against one repository hosting leaked Claude Code source code and its forks. The repo named in the notice was part of a fork network connected to our own public Claude Code repo, so the takedown reached more repositories than intended. We retracted the notice for everything except the one repo we named

key_facts.fact: The leaked code revealed 44 unreleased feature flags including KAIROS (autonomous background agent mode), ULTRAPLAN (30-min remote planning), coordinator mode (multi-agent orchestration), and a 'dream mode' for background memory consolidation.
key_facts.excerpt: 44 feature flags (KAIROS, ULTRAPLAN, coordinator mode)... Unreleased autonomous agent mode, 30-min remote planning, multi-agent orchestration, background memory consolidation

key_facts.fact: Security researchers mapped three practical attack paths from the readable source: context poisoning via the compaction pipeline, sandbox bypass through shell parsing differentials, and their composition.
key_facts.excerpt: A technical analysis from Straiker's Jun Zhou... mapped three compositions that are now practical, not theoretical, because the implementation is legible

key_facts.fact: A Gartner First Take called the cluster of March incidents at Anthropic a 'systemic signal,' noting this was the second leak in five days after a CMS misconfiguration exposed draft announcements for an unreleased model called Claude Mythos.
key_facts.excerpt: This was the second leak in five days. A separate CMS misconfiguration had already exposed nearly 3,000 unpublished internal assets, including draft announcements for an unreleased model called Claude Mythos. Gartner called the cluster of March incidents a systemic signal

key_facts.fact: An 'undercover mode' module in the leaked source strips AI attribution from git commits with no force-off option, raising concerns about code provenance in regulated industries.
key_facts.excerpt: 90-line module strips AI attribution from commits. Force ON possible, force OFF impossible

stories.headline: Cognichip Raises $60M Series A to Build AI Models for Chip Design, Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan Joins Board

key_facts.fact: Cognichip raised $60 million in a Series A led by Seligman Ventures, with Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan participating and joining the board, bringing total funding to $93 million since 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: it had raised $60 million in new funding led by Seligman Ventures, with notable participation from Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan, who will be joining Cognichip's board... Cognichip has now raised $93 million altogether since its founding in 2024

key_facts.fact: The company is building a deep learning model trained on chip design data to work alongside engineers, claiming it can reduce chip development costs by more than 75% and cut timelines by more than half.
key_facts.excerpt: the firm's technology can reduce the cost of chip development by more than 75% and cut the timeline by more than half

key_facts.fact: Advanced chips currently take 3-5 years from conception to mass production, with the design phase alone taking up to two years before physical layout begins.
key_facts.excerpt: Advanced chips take three to five years to go from conception to mass production; the design phase alone can take as long as two years before physical layout begins

key_facts.fact: Cognichip uses its own model trained on chip design data rather than a general-purpose LLM, developing proprietary and synthetic datasets since open chip design data is scarce.
key_facts.excerpt: The company says its advantage is in using its own model trained on chip design data, rather than starting with a general-purpose LLM

key_facts.fact: Cognichip competes with incumbents Synopsys and Cadence, as well as startups ChipAgents ($74M extended Series A in February) and Ricursive ($300M Series A in January).
key_facts.excerpt: Cognichip is competing against incumbent players like Synopsys and Cadence Design Systems, as well as well-funded startups like ChipAgents, which closed a $74 million extended Series A in February, and Ricursive, which raised a $300 million Series A round in January

stories.headline: ROCKET Upgrades AlphaFold to Learn From Raw Experimental Data, Published in Nature Methods

key_facts.fact: ROCKET is a new software tool that extends AlphaFold's capabilities to accommodate raw experimental data from X-ray crystallography, cryo-electron microscopy, and electron tomography, published April 1 in Nature Methods.
key_facts.excerpt: ROCKET extends AlphaFold's capabilities to accommodate raw experimental data. Its creators present the tool in a paper published April 1 in Nature Methods

key_facts.fact: AlphaFold previously could only use atomic models of data (which take weeks of human effort to build); ROCKET automates the model building from raw data in a fully automated and reliable manner.
key_facts.excerpt: AlphaFold can only accommodate atomic models of the data — representations that make the data more interpretable, but that can take weeks of human effort to build

key_facts.fact: ROCKET was built by integrating SFCalculator (which links atomic models to their underlying data) with OpenFold (an open-source version of AlphaFold), by teams from Flatiron Institute, Harvard, Columbia, Cambridge, and other institutions.
key_facts.excerpt: Li and Fadini integrated SFCalculator with OpenFold and voila: ROCKET was born

key_facts.fact: ROCKET can jump between different plausible protein conformations in ways unlike traditional methods, enabling better understanding of how proteins change shape when interacting with other molecules — critical for drug design.
key_facts.excerpt: We found that ROCKET can jump from one plausible conformation to another... The jumps it makes are unlike anything traditional methods would do

key_facts.fact: The tool will be integrated into PHENIX (widely used structure-determination software), Harvard's SBGrid, and the open-source RS-Station platform.
key_facts.excerpt: The tool will be integrated into PHENIX... Harvard's SBGrid... and RS-Station

sources.title: Introducing ROCKET: An Upgrade to AlphaFold That Learns From Raw Experimental Data

stories.headline: Zhipu AI Launches GLM-5V-Turbo, a Native Multimodal Vision Coding Model With 200K Context

key_facts.fact: Zhipu AI (Z.ai) released GLM-5V-Turbo, a vision coding model that natively processes images, videos, design drafts, and document layouts to generate code, using a CogViT vision encoder and MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) architecture.
key_facts.excerpt: GLM-5V-Turbo is a vision coding model designed to address this specifically through Native Multimodal Coding... CogViT Vision Encoder... MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) Architecture

key_facts.fact: The model supports a 200K context window with up to 128K output tokens for repository-scale tasks, and was trained with 30+ task joint reinforcement learning to avoid the 'see-saw' effect between visual and coding capabilities.
key_facts.excerpt: supporting a 200K context window and up to 128K output tokens for repository-scale tasks... developed using 30+ Task Joint Reinforcement Learning

key_facts.fact: GLM-5V-Turbo is specifically optimized for OpenClaw and Claude Code agentic workflows, enabling the 'perceive, plan, execute' loop for autonomous environment interaction.
key_facts.excerpt: optimized for OpenClaw and Claude Code workflows, mastering the 'perceive → plan → execute' loop for autonomous environment interaction

key_facts.fact: The model achieves SOTA performance on specialized benchmarks including CC-Bench-V2 (multimodal coding) and ZClawBench (OpenClaw GUI agent scenarios).
key_facts.excerpt: It delivers SOTA performance on specialized agentic leaderboards, including CC-Bench-V2 (coding/repo exploration) and ZClawBench (GUI agent interaction)

sources.title: Z.ai Launches GLM-5V-Turbo: A Native Multimodal Vision Coding Model Optimized for OpenClaw and High-Capacity Agentic Engineering Workflows
